支持 AI 批量课程配音吗？: Can I generate narration for an entire course?
支持。配音项目可导入 TXT / CSV / TSV / DOCX / PPTX: Yes. Projects import TXT, CSV, TSV, DOCX and PPTX scripts and organize them by chapter, role and paragraph. Generate or redo individual lines and compare previous takes. DOCX extracts body text and tables. PPTX reads speaker notes first, falling back to slide text; there is no OCR or PDF import. Quick tasks and CLI batches support up to 5,000 characters and 100 segments; CLI segments are limited to 600 characters each. Projects can store up to 10,000 lines and 500,000 characters, splitting long lines into short segments for sequential generation. Organize long courses by chapter.

我的电脑能运行吗？: Will it run on my computer?
提供 macOS 14+ 的 Apple 芯片和 Intel 芯片两种安装包；W: Installers are available for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14+. Windows requires x64 and Windows 10 2004 (19041) or later; Windows 11 is recommended. Light mode needs at least 8 GB RAM; standard, character and reference modes need at least 16 GB, subject to the app’s checks. Intel Mac and Windows builds use CPU inference without CUDA; full acceptance testing on those platforms is still pending. Disk needs vary by platform, packages and existing downloads. Check the app before buying. Linux and Windows ARM are not supported.
支持声音设计与声音克隆吗？: Can I design or clone a voice?
可以用文字描述人物声线，也可直接录音，或从有权使用的录音中选取 3–30 秒清晰: Describe a character’s voice in words, record a sample, or select 3–30 seconds of clear speech you have permission to use and provide its exact transcript. An optional local transcription package of about 486 MB can help fill in the transcript; review it manually. Character voices use a chosen sample for future lines and retakes. Redefining a voice or using free-form design may change its sound. Standard preset voices support expression per line; light mode supports natural delivery only. Locked character voices retain their sample’s expression. Voice cloning retains the recording’s expression by default; a separate optional expression package can be downloaded explicitly.
能编辑音频、配背景音乐和导出字幕吗？: Can I edit audio, add music and export subtitles?
可以比较历史版本，裁剪波形、调整音量和淡入淡出，保存后用于后续试听和导出，原始音: Compare takes, trim waveforms, adjust volume and add fades while preserving the original audio. Projects can import background music, loop it and lower it during speech. Preview the first 30 seconds of the mix, then export merged WAV, MP3, SRT and ZIP. A finished export supports up to 5,000 audio segments and six hours; export longer projects by chapter. SRT timing follows generated segments, not word-level recognition or video alignment. The CLI’s regular ZIP export packages individual audio files without project mixing or subtitles.
能接入哪些 AI 智能体？会省 token 吗？: Which AI agents work with it? Does it save tokens?
支持具备本地命令执行能力的智能体，例如 Codex、Claude Code、Wo: Agents that can execute local commands, such as Codex, Claude Code and WorkBuddy, can call the CLI. The local model generates audio and returns file paths rather than embedding the audio in the conversation. Agent writing and reasoning remain subject to the provider’s charges; token use depends on the workflow. External agents handle scripts according to their own settings. There is no dedicated MCP server. The installer includes the CLI, and creation requires activation.
